title: RWB-S6-E5024-APP: the lot build and price slice has no plan row for its four consumed contracts, its agent contract, the R-DS-04 criterion split, the rules that carry no value or the outbox library
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R5.7, R7.3 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E5024-APP; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale (service row, ownership rows, Architecture v5 slides 3, 4, 5, 8 and 13, Temporal and Drools slides 5, 12 and 13); legacy RWB-E5-024; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A1.3, A1.4, A2.2, A2.5.3.1 and Requirements served; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1 to T3.3, T4, T5.1, T5.3, T6.1, T6.2 and T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-04, R-DS-05 and R-DS-19; Recovery Workbench Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 rows FEAT-DBS-01, FEAT-DBS-02 and FEAT-DBS-16
description: (1) The plan gives H = RWB-S6-E5024-CON, RWB-PLT-E1027-CON and RWB-PLT-N001-CON with C, I and X empty, while the step reads the rwb-case case facts, the rwb-source-data COLLINS lot economics, the rwb-agent estimate and the rwb-decision package, so four consumed rows have no plan row, and DP-20, the agent client that would add C RWB-P10-TE013-CON, is not in the pattern set of this key. (2) The service owns topic rwb.debtsale.events.v1 with event EV-23, yet DP-09 is absent, so the outbox and inbox library RWB-PLT-TE006-CON is absent from the H row. (3) DP-04 is absent although the step evaluates R-DS-04 and R-DS-05 of the DS route set of 41 rules over 29 states. (4) R-DS-04's condition is produced by this feature, while its criterion is legacy RWB-E6-001 AC3 and its transition and 5 working days are RWB-S6-E6001-APP's, so one rule is split across two stories with no plan row that records it. (5) The minimum lot size of R-DS-05, the tiered buyer terms and the reserve policy are values no source gives, and the FSD section of this feature declares no business rule row of its own. (6) The FSD names a Model gateway as the second integration point, and the S6 row of the connection matrix names no call to rwb-agent. (7) The legacy Data table names recovery_case and rule_row, which this service may not read or write, and the legacy endpoints carry the monolith base /api/recovery/v1. (8) The split plan carries no requirement id for this slice.
evidence: split plan slice RWB-S6-E5024-APP with three H rows and empty C, I and X; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 rows DP-04, DP-05, DP-09, DP-19 and DP-20; context pack ownership rows (debt_sale_lot and debt_sale_account, S6; 5 REST operations; event EV-23; workflow DebtSaleWorkflow) and connection-matrix row S6 (Temporal to P7 and P5, Temporal and event to P8, Temporal to P2, no P10 cell); FSD S6 A2.2.2 (integration points ACE and Model gateway) and A2.2.3.1 (only VR-S6-002-1 and BR-S6-002); TSD S6 T3.1, T4 (R-DS-04 and R-DS-05), T5.3 and T-A.1; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-04 and R-DS-05; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 FEAT-DBS-02 (ACE and Model gateway) and FEAT-DBS-16; legacy RWB-E5-024 Data, Endpoints and Acceptance criteria
area: Dependency, ownership, rule split and requirement trace
proposed: Keep the plan's H, C, I and X rows as they stand; record the rwb-case, rwb-source-data, rwb-agent and rwb-decision rows as class C in fact with their placeholders; record RWB-P10-TE013-CON as the agent contract the estimate needs and RWB-PLT-TE006-CON as the wave 0 library the service's topic needs; read the minimum lot size, the tiered terms and the reserve policy from the package, and record their values as rule rows with a placeholder; keep R-DS-04's criterion with RWB-S6-E6001-APP and its condition with this story; adopt REQ-S6-002 for traceability

title: RWB-S6-E5024-CON: the priced properties, the agent estimate element, the four consumed operation names and the field list of the COLLINS lot economics have no published baseline
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5, R7.2 and R9; split plan slice RWB-S6-E5024-CON; context pack S6 rwb-debtsale; legacy RWB-E5-024; FSD S6 Debt sale v3 A2.2.2, A2.2.3.1, A2.2.4.4 and Requirements served; TSD S6 Debt sale v2 T2, T3.1, T3.2, T4, T5.1, T5.3, T6.1 and T-A.1 and T-A.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DS-04 and R-DS-05
description: (1) TSD S6 T3.1 gives the physical types of debt_sale_lot and debt_sale_account but publishes no OpenAPI element, so the priced properties, their optionality and the priced answer are fixed by this baseline, not copied from a source. (2) No source publishes the operation that returns the price estimate, and the FSD names a Model gateway with no operation, no element and no model-version field, so the estimate row carries a placeholder. (3) The rwb-source-data data-product catalogue names the COLLINS score but publishes no operation name and no field list for the lot economics, so that row carries a placeholder. (4) No source publishes the rwb-case case-facts read name or the package read name. (5) TSD S6 T-A.2 gives the error set as status codes with no message id per condition, so each condition is bound to a message of the legacy and FSD set. (6) The event set of the topic is named in the architecture, not in an AsyncAPI catalogue, so LotAwarded (EV-23) and AccountsTransferred are named from the service's event list and declared as the later stories'. (7) The plan's C, I and X rows of this slice are empty while the contract declares four consumed rows, and the same two operations are already baselined by RWB-S6-E5023-CON, so additivity is a rule this baseline must state and test.
evidence: TSD S6 T-A.1 operations API-S6-001 and API-S6-002 and T-A.2 error lists 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 and 503 without message ids; TSD S6 T3.1 field list DF-SAL-020 to DF-SAL-037 and T3.2 lists; FSD S6 A2.2.2 (ACE and Model gateway) and A2.2.4.4 (no background event); context pack ownership rows (5 REST operations, event EV-23, tables debt_sale_lot and debt_sale_account); legacy RWB-E5-024 Data, Endpoints, Validation and messages, and Test cases; baseline of RWB-S6-E5023-CON for the same two operations
proposed: Publish the priced part of the one service document as an additive change within major version 1, bind every error condition to one message id of section 14, declare the estimate element with its model version and the placeholder operation names, fix the minimum lot size as a rule row and never as a property, and record the tag date and the consumer sign-off in the contract README
